train_GNN_model: train a GNN-based sequence model for one epoch using an iterator and optimizer
evaluate_GNN_model: evaluate a GNN-based sequence model on an iterator and return loss and accuracy
cal_performance: calculate cross-entropy loss and word-level accuracy with optional label smoothing
preprocessing_graph: build a DGL graph from source token indices and edge triples with node annotations
graph_src: batch multiple DGL graphs from a batch of source sequences and edge lists
